dashboard.label: SSH Security Operations Center
dashboard.description: Professional Incident Responder view for SSH authentication activity

search.query: index=main source="*auth.log*" "Failed password" | rex "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats dc(src_ip)

index=main source="*auth.log*" ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password") | rex "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | eval status=if(match(_raw,"Failed password"),"Failed","Success") | stats count(eval(status="Failed")) as f, count(eval(status="Success")) as s by src_ip | where f>3 AND s>0 | stats count
index=main source="*auth.log*" "Failed password" | timechart span=10m count

panel.title: Authentication Events Over Time (Failed vs Success)

search.query: index=main source="*auth.log*" ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password") | eval status=if(match(_raw,"Failed password"),"Failed","Success") | timechart span=10m count by status
index=main source="*auth.log*" "Failed password" | rex "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats count as attempts, dc(user) as users_targeted by src_ip | sort - attempts | head 20
index=main source="*auth.log*" "Failed password" | rex "for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from" | stats count as attempts, dc(src_ip) as sources by user | sort - attempts | head 20

panel.title: ⚠️ Potential Compromises — Failed then Successful Login

search.query: index=main source="*auth.log*" ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password") | rex "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | eval status=if(match(_raw,"Failed password"),"Failed","Success") | stats min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen, count(eval(status="Failed")) as failures, count(eval(status="Success")) as successes by src_ip | where failures>3 AND successes>0 | eval severity=case(failures>50,"CRITICAL", failures>20,"HIGH", failures>5,"MEDIUM", true(),"LOW") | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - failures

index=main source="*auth.log*" ("Accepted password for root" OR "Accepted publickey for root" OR "Failed password for root") | rex "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | eval result=if(match(_raw,"Accepted"),"SUCCESS","FAILED") | table _time, host, src_ip, result, _raw | sort - _time
index=main source="*auth.log*" "Invalid user" | rex "Invalid user (?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats count by user, src_ip | sort - count | head 20
index=main source="*auth.log*" "COMMAND=" | rex "sudo:\s+(?<user>\S+)\s+:.*COMMAND=(?<command>.+)" | stats count by user, command | sort - count
index=main source="*auth.log*" ("useradd" OR "new user" OR "new group" OR "groupadd") | table _time, host, _raw | sort - _time

index=main source="*auth.log*" ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password" OR "Invalid user" OR "session opened") | rex "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | eval event_type=case(match(_raw,"Failed password"),"FAILED", match(_raw,"Accepted password"),"SUCCESS", match(_raw,"Invalid user"),"INVALID", match(_raw,"session opened"),"SESSION", true(),"OTHER") | table _time, host, src_ip, event_type, _raw | sort - _time

panel.title: Login Activity by Hour of Day

search.query: index=main source="*auth.log*" "Accepted password" | eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H") | stats count by hour | sort hour

index=main source="*auth.log*" | eval outcome=case(match(_raw,"Failed password"),"Failed", match(_raw,"Accepted password"),"Accepted", match(_raw,"Invalid user"),"Invalid user", true(),"Other") | stats count by outcome

index=main source="*auth.log*" "Failed password" | rex "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats count as attempts by src_ip | eval severity=case(attempts>50,"CRITICAL", attempts>20,"HIGH", attempts>5,"MEDIUM", true(),"LOW") | where attempts>5 | sort - attempts
